name: ToggleButton
rungReason: <button aria-pressed> is the native pattern, but no attribute flips it: the HTML path needs data-lue-toggle, React keeps state.

a11y.name: Its text, which doesn't change with the state

elementRules: The behaviour listens for clicks at the document, writes only aria-pressed on [data-lue-toggle] buttons, skips cancelled clicks, and fires a bubbling lue-toggle event (detail.pressed). React never renders data-lue-toggle.
withoutJavaScript: It shows its initial state and doesn't change; give it a form fallback when the state must be saved
contrast: As Button: a solid ring when pressed
